keywords: Appeal against District Court judgement delivered at the re-trial for declaration of title and ejectment of the Appellant; failure to object to documents at closure of a case is evidence for all purposes of the law; improper procedure followed by Court; Registration of Documents Ordinance. Held - Respondents had not discharged burden of proof to establish title, and identity of corpus. Appeal allowed with costs.
